name: data_profiling
description: Exact DuckDB profiling with schema-directed native aggregate plans

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', {recursive: true, force: true})" && tsc && node -e "require('node:fs').copyFileSync('src/fg_worker.py', 'dist/fg_worker.py')"
scripts.test: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test .test-dist/tests/*.test.js
